bootstrap.template: Read docs/ai/WORKFLOW_PROFILE.md, docs/ai/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, docs/ai/PROGRESS_LOG.md, and docs/ai/ACTIVE_WORK.md. If profile is unconfigured, ask the meta-question once. Otherwise summarize posture + current state and propose next step with verification command.

reconfigure-workflow.template: Re-run the workflow profile flow using docs/ai/templates/WORKFLOW_PRESETS.md. Ask the meta-question, apply preset or custom dimensions, update docs/ai/WORKFLOW_PROFILE.md, and summarize what changed.

design.template: Assess complexity L0–L3. For non-trivial work, follow .opencode/skills/engineering-design/SKILL.md: discover existing architecture, separate requirements from proposed solutions, write/update the Design Spec under docs/ai/<DOMAIN>/ using the design template, then run design-review when L2+.

design-review.template: Review the active Design Spec using .opencode/skills/design-review/SKILL.md. Record verdict Ready / Ready with deferred items / Not ready. Do not start large implementation on Not ready.

handoff.template: Append today's work to docs/ai/PROGRESS_LOG.md using the progress log entry template. Create a session note. Mark incomplete slices as Blocked/Deferred with reason. Provide the first concrete action for the next session.

register-feature.template: Register a new feature ID in docs/ai/FEATURE_REGISTRY.md using the <DOMAIN>-F<nn> scheme. Find the next available number for the given domain. Assess complexity and link Design Spec path when known.
